fronts:
Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Edit target: attached six-character reference sheet. Produce a production-ready TRANSPARENT pixel-art RPG sprite sheet, six characters in exactly the same 3 column x 2 row order: Yato hood, Danming fairy, Kubby goblin; Yune veiled, Dori, Fuwa. Keep their specific costumes, hair, eyes, ornaments, halos and existing slender chibi proportions and relaxed front-standing poses faithful to the reference. No labels or text. Full bodies with feet and every ornament inside each cell, ample transparent gutters, no ground shadow.
The actual game sprites need sharp deliberate pixel clusters at approximately 64 x 90 logical pixels per character, shown enlarged with a perfectly square pixel grid. Sheet logical resolution 192 x 180, enlarged cleanly about 6 times. All figures at same crown-to-sole height of about 70 logical pixels, feet at bottom of each cell, halos above. Keep head-to-body proportion around 1:3.1 from crown to sole, not oversized heads; no shortened torsos or squashing. Front facing, both arms resting down away from sides, shoulders and elbows connected.
Upgrade readability and attractive pixel craftsmanship: dark colored one-pixel outlines, clear symmetric compact eyes with one highlight, tidy face not too much blush, hair grouped into coherent light/mid/shadow locks, smooth stepped silhouettes, crisp fabric folds and trim, distinct hands and footwear. Limited intentional palettes around 28-40 colors per character, no dithering or noise, no antialiasing, no gradients, no painterly blur.
Identity requirements: top left long golden hair with white floppy rabbit hood with gold trim, red eyes, gold bunny halo, white cropped cape and black shorts, white thighhighs; top middle short peach hair red eyes golden crescent and halo, four pink butterfly fairy wings, pale blue/white layered ruffles with red ribbon, pink boots; top right short brown hair green forelock and green eyes, small horns, floral hairpins, open green and gold goblin coat over black cropped outfit, purple tall boots; bottom left long dark violet hair with white and gold veil, violet eyes, long white gathered gown with gold edges and gold halo; bottom middle pink curled twin tails, raccoon ears, small pink halo, burgundy eyes, charcoal cape pink trim and pink clasp, dark pleated skirt and stockings, pink shoes; bottom right white/lilac hair in paired round buns with blue flower/star, blue eyes, blue halo, white/lilac layered kimono-like coat with blue obi and yellow ornament, pale boots. Preserve these costume differences exactly. The reference supplies all designs. Do not redesign their clothing. Transparent background.
